name: Will removing my pool increase my property value or affect my home insurance?

mainEntity.name: Will removing my pool increase my property value or affect my home insurance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing your pool can potentially improve your property's marketability, especially in areas where pools are not highly desired or where lot space is at a premium. While it doesn't always guarantee an increase in appraisal value, it can make your home more appealing to a broader range of buyers. Regarding insurance, removing a pool typically leads to lower home insurance premiums, as it eliminates a significant liability risk. It's advisable to inform your insurance provider after removal to adjust your policy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pool removal can improve marketability and often lowers home insurance premiums by reducing liability. It doesn't guarantee a property value increase but can appeal to more buyers.
